name: EFFECTS
summary: Dial a look on a frame or a clip — scanner glass, analog video, or a mosaic of tiles. Every knob is named for what you see, so an agent can drive it from a description.

surface.hint: put a look on a frame — and tell an agent to change it

_roots_note: Optional on purpose. With no media bound the app renders a built-in test frame rather than an empty stage, so the effect can be seen and driven on a machine that has no pictures on it yet. An app that needs content to prove it works cannot be evaluated before someone commits content to it.

provider._note: A reference, not a run spec. The effect capability belongs to the package that implements it, which is what lets a timeline app apply the same look without owning any of this.
